title: A narrow escape
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: a flooded stone-and-iron maintenance tunnel beneath the lighthouse, knee-deep seawater, dripping pipes, rusted conduits. Time and weather: dim interior lit by handheld lamps and emerald glows, cold blue shadows.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks; Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; a swarm of tiny brass-and-gunmetal maintenance drones with spindly legs and single crimson eye-lights, scuttling and hovering.
Camera: medium shot at a heavy bulkhead door; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: The masked hero fires a spray of orange grapple cables that knot into a net across a doorway, holding back the swarm, while Penny rips open a lock panel and reroutes the wires with her pliers. The door begins to slide shut behind them.
No dialogue.
Sound: cable launches, net thwump, sparking wires, buzzing swarm, heavy door clang.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (the masked hero, Penny, maintenance drones), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: The door clangs shut, leaving the swarm buzzing on the other side.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: cable launches, net thwump, sparking wires, buzzing swarm, heavy door clang.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
negative_prompt: text, captions, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra limbs, duplicated characters, sudden wardrobe changes, costume swaps, graphic injury, blood, gore, still image, slideshow, freeze frame, live action humans, 2D flat animation, anime, background music
